{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check if any of the 6 QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) are in the filtered group
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check if any QA row is NEW, PAID_SEARCH, and completed
qa_in_filtered = qa_rows[
    (qa_rows['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (qa_rows['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (qa_rows['status'] == 'completed')
]

print(f"Number of QA rows (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_rows)}")
print(f"Number of QA rows in the filtered group (NEW, PAID_SEARCH, completed): {len(qa_in_filtered)}")

# If any QA rows are in the filtered group, they must be excluded
if len(qa_in_filtered) > 0:
    print("WARNING: QA rows are present in the filtered group. They must be excluded.")
    # Exclude them from the filtered dataset
    filtered = df[
        (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
        (df['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
        (df['status'] == 'completed') &
        (df['revenue'] != '999999.99')
    ]
    num_converted = filtered['converted'].sum()
    num_total = len(filtered)
    fraction = num_converted / num_total if num_total > 0 else 0.0
else:
    # Use original filtered data
    filtered = df[
        (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
        (df['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
        (df['status'] == 'completed')
    ]
    num_converted = filtered['converted'].sum()
    num_total = len(filtered)
    fraction = num_converted / num_total if num_total > 0 else 0.0

print(f"Final number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH with completed status: {num_total}")
print(f"Final number who converted: {num_converted}")
print(f"Final conversion fraction: {fraction}")

fraction"}
